name: bug-reporter
description: Create evidence-based, fix-ready bug reports for software and systems.

interface.longDescription: Creates, investigates, improves, and saves fix-ready Markdown bug reports with minimal reproduction steps, exact environments, defect-specific evidence, honest diagnosis, safe disclosure, and verifiable acceptance criteria.
defaultPrompt: Turn these logs and reproduction notes into a saved, fix-ready bug report.
Improve and save this bug report without inventing missing evidence.
Investigate this intermittent failure and save a report.
